title: Calcifer
description: Calcifer, a fire demon in his hearth: Claude's animated persona. He talks while Claude's replies are spoken (lip-synced to the real audio, word timings and phonemes in feed mode) and shows whatever mood Claude gives him.

mood.help: Set Calcifer's expression (held until changed, or for --for seconds)

react.help: A one-shot reaction: flare up, sputter low, throw sparks, wince

say.help: Make him mouth some text now (speech normally follows your replies by itself)

mic.help: The user's mic: off, wake (he listens for his name), or open (a conversation)

mute.help: Mute or unmute his voice (he still mouths the words)

micDevice.label: Your microphone: its name or part of it, e.g. AirPods (blank: the default mic, skipping loopback devices)

feedSession.label: Speech feed session id (blank: this project)

feedPlayAudio.label: Play Claude's voice himself (feed mode; mute other players)

feedDelay.label: Voice delay when another app plays it (ms, feed mode)

autoSpeak.label: Talk along with Claude's replies (text mode)
